author: 9to5Google
description:
Welcome to Pixelated episode 124. This week, Damien, Abner, and Will dive into the announcement of Motorola's flagship return in North America, the Signature 27. Is a $1,600 non-foldable the comeback everyone hoped for, or is this device doomed by rising component costs? Then, with Apple's HomeView smart display set to launch next week, the gang examines Google's lack of a modernized competitor and wonder what they'd want to see from a relaunch in 2027.
